text_block_list.text:
While out shopping on my day off,
I ran into a rather noisy group...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I bought three boxes and still didn't get it...?
*urgh*! I ate too much, my stomach hurts...

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
King! Just give up on pulling it yourself already!
Eating any more of these sweets is gonna kill us!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! I can't let you push yourselves too hard.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fine then... Digital-san.
I'll take you up on that trade offer...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyoeh, thank you so much for agreeing!
I mean, I'm so sorry for just blurting it out
all of a sudden...!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, it's a huge help~. No matter how many I ate,
I just couldn't pull King, so I was in a real pinch~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I-I-Is that true?! I am quite accustomed to eating massive amounts of chocolate! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"If you buy as many as I do, you get tons of dupes,
so I'm sure you'll pull multiple King-sans too!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if it isn't Trainer!
Ehehe, we're talking about "Umamusume Choco Eggs"~!
King and the others came to buy some too...

'Uma Musume Choco Egg'……
If I recall, it's a series of candy toys
where a figure comes inside an egg-shaped chocolate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I, King, have granted the rights
for merchandise in this new series as well...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Well then, Miss King!
I'll inspect the contents promptly and get in touch with you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, aahn! Unbelievable...!
I actually get to be useful to my fave...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Today we're having a grand unboxing ceremony~!!
20 boxes with 10 packs each!
Let's rip 'em all open in one gooo~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Gfufu...! *drool*...!
Eating chocolate while admiring Umamusume figures is bound to be the ultimate sweetness...♪"
choice_data_list: Let's enjoy it to our heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mumu, so true!
Gaining weight would interfere with sacred races...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll save the chocolates
and eat them bit by bit~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'd be happy no matter who shows up, but this time
I'd love it if there were lots of King-sans~♪

"And so, Agnes Digital
hustled on home, clutching a huge stack of boxes."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hai-ee!!
I need to prepare drinks that go well with chocolate too~♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Gfufu~!
Tonight's gonna be a feast, oh yeah~~!"

"And so, Agnes Digital
headed back home, panting heavily all the way..."
